success_criterion.name: primary_clean_equivs_cell_mae_vs_endpoint_and_logridge
success_criterion.note: Descriptive practical screen; not a hypothesis test; primary must beat BOTH endpoint and logridge on pooled cell-equal clean MAE over B4/B6 by at least 10% each, and neither B4 nor B6 protocol may be >0.25pp worse than either comparator.
